description.value: Bin 4 Burger Lounge is a BC-born gourmet burger chain founded in 2011, now with seven locations including this Westshore outpost at 716 Goldstream Avenue. The menu leans on locally sourced ingredients—natural BC beef, Fraser Valley free-run chicken, and seasonal produce—paired with a wide roster of house-made aiolis and craft-inspired cocktails. The casual lounge format offers dine-in, online ordering, and a daily happy hour, making it a solid refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the Langford corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active with current seasonal promotions and an April 2026 community fundraiser, confirming the business is open. The OSM address (716 Goldstream Avenue) corresponds to the Victoria–Westshore location listed on the website's location menu, though the contact page was truncated before displaying the Westshore address and phone number, so those fields cannot be cross-verified. Takeout is confirmed via the prominent 'Order Online' call-to-action; vegetarian and vegan options are confirmed through multiple menu items (tofu substitutions, vegan dressing, vegan aioli, Aloo Tikki vegetarian patty); no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; the website contact page was truncated before showing the Victoria–Westshore location's specific phone and address, so neither could be cross-verified.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible full-service restaurant confirmed open via current website content. A legitimate refuelling stop for touring cyclists on the Westshore corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu offers tofu substitutions ('sub blackened tofu'), a BIN 4 BOWL with tofu, vegan red pepper dressing, vegan red pepper garlic aioli dip, and the Bin 4 Spiced Aloo Tikki vegetarian patty (potato, peas, cilantro)
